command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e \
  && echo '=== perf.yml current ===' \
  && cat .github/workflows/perf.yml \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== local-bridge surface ===' \
  && find apps/local-bridge -name '*.rs' -path '*/tests/*' | head -10 \
  && echo '--- test harness imports ---' \
  && head -25 apps/local-bridge/tests/handoff_dispatch.rs 2>/dev/null \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== local-bridge bin entry ===' \
  && find apps/local-bridge/src -maxdepth 1 -name 'main.rs' -o -name 'lib.rs' | xargs -I {} head -20 {} 2>/dev/null \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== plans status: planned slices ===' \
  && grep -l 'status: planned' docs/plans/wiring/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -10 \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== existing plans index ===' \
  && head -50 docs/plans/wiring/00-index.md \
  && echo '' \
  && echo '=== plans README ===' \
  && head -40 docs/plans/README.md
